messages:
yasmin: Sales asked if tenants can schedule "peak windows" to auto-route to a low-cost quantized variant. They want a short playbook + rollback ladder before we let customers enable it.
omar: Ok. We should require tenant-admin consent in Console and capture an emergency contact. No auto-enrollment.
felix: Runtime plan: implement scheduled routing policy keyed by tenant id + time window. Warmup ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% by default, each step gated.
toni: Define gates: p95 latency delta < +25% OR absolute p95 < 350ms, error-rate delta < 0.4%, and quality delta on customer prompt set < 1.0%. Any gate fail -> immediate revert for that tenant.
yasmin: We also need audit logs and email receipts when a tenant toggles the schedule. CS asked for an opt-in summary email.
felix: Circuit-breaker: if EU GPU pool > 82% for 3m OR router queue > 250ms for 3m -> pause all scheduled warmups and divert to premium pool.
ops-bot: staging-job queued: schedule-optin-probe -> duration 48h -> owner:felix.
toni: Small-tenant rule: tenants < 5TPS require min 24h observation even if gates pass. Show "stability pending" in Console.
omar: Feature flags: per-tenant boolean schedule_enabled, and global force_pinned_variant flag for emergency rollbacks.
yasmin: Who owns playbook? Felix -> router + circuit-breaker, Toni -> gating & evals, Omar -> Console + audit, Yasmin -> product signoff and customer comms.
felix: I'll push a staging config tomorrow and start the 48h probe if no blockers.
yasmin: Great. Please add the rollback ladder steps to the runbook: 1) disable schedule in Console, 2) set force_pinned_variant=true, 3) divert EU opt-in to premium pool, 4) open incident if systemic.
toni: lgtm.
